subject: Upcoming Travel Plans Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], I am writing to confirm your upcoming travel plans to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for June 15th at 9:00 AM and your hotel reservation is confirmed from June 15th to June 20th. Please find attached your itinerary for more details. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you to Paris! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
